test_compressed_uncompressed_model_shape: test that compressed and uncompressed model weights match within tolerance
test_no_warnings_for_all_models: test that loading compressed tensor models produces no missing or unexpected key warnings
test_default_run_compressed_true: test that models loaded by default keep linear modules in compressed quantization state
test_default_run_compressed_false: test that run_compressed=False decompresses all modules so none stay in compressed state
test_run_compressed_outputs_match: test that model generation output is identical whether run_compressed is true or false
